prompt:
Sprite sheet for a 2D adventure game. The character is the badger courier from the first reference image, a character sheet: keep exactly his costume, colours, body proportions and drawing style (clean dark outlines, flat colour fills with soft cel shading, hand-painted cartoon look); ignore its layout with three views and its magenta background. Neutral even light from the front-top, no rim light, no cast shadow, no ground. Not a 3D render, not plush, not a photograph. The second reference image is his walk cycle from the same game: draw him at exactly the same scale, with the same line weight, the same colours and the same level of detail as there.
The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.
Layout: one single horizontal row of 6 animation frames of a friendly greeting wave, evenly spaced across the full width. The badger stands still, turned three-quarters towards the viewer (body facing front-right, face and smile turned to the viewer), both feet planted on the same baseline in every frame. Sides are given as seen in the image: the parcel is tucked under the arm on the LEFT side of the image in every single frame, the satchel hangs on the left side of the image in every frame, and it is always the arm on the RIGHT side of the image that waves; the parcel never changes arms and the waving arm never changes sides. The waving paw: 1 down at his side; 2 rising to shoulder height; 3 raised high above the cap, open palm, tilted to the left; 4 the same raised paw tilted to the right; 5 tilted to the left again; 6 lowering to shoulder height. Big friendly smile, eyes open; body, head, legs, parcel and scarf stay exactly the same in all six frames, only the waving arm moves.
Every frame is a complete, separate drawing of the whole character at the same scale; clear empty space between neighbouring frames, nothing touching or overlapping, no frame borders, no numbers, no labels, no ground line. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
